---
title: "Global Health Papers"
toc: false
page-layout: full
---

Results pulled live from [OpenAlex's](https://openalex.org) API each time you load this page. Use the filters to narrow by topic, journal, or date.<br>
All journals and topics are selected by default. You can toggle off the ones you want and click the search button to update.<br>
Please [get in touch](about.qmd) with suggestions on journals to add or ways to improve this feed. <br>
All papers are included from the Global Health specialist journals, and only papers tagged with one or more of the sustainable development goals are included from the high-impact generalist journals.

```{=html}
  <span class="concept-tag" data-id="6">SDG 6: Clean water &amp; sanitation</span>
  <span class="concept-tag" data-id="7">SDG 7: Clean energy</span>
  <span class="concept-tag" data-id="8">SDG 8: Decent work</span>
  <span class="concept-tag" data-id="9">SDG 9: Industry &amp; innovation</span>

  <span class="concept-tag" data-id="11">SDG 11: Sustainable cities &amp; communities</span>
  <span class="concept-tag" data-id="12">SDG 12: Responsible consumption &amp; production</span>
  <span class="concept-tag" data-id="13">SDG 13: Climate action</span>
  <span class="concept-tag" data-id="14">SDG 14: Life below water</span>
  <span class="concept-tag" data-id="15">SDG 15: Life on land</span>
  <span class="concept-tag" data-id="16">SDG 16: Peace, justice &amp; strong institutions</span>

</div>

<hr class="oa-divider">

<div class="oa-filters">
  <div class="oa-filter-group">
    <label>From date</label>
    <input type="date" id="fromDate">
  </div>
  <div class="oa-filter-group">
    <label>To date</label>
    <input type="date" id="toDate">
  </div>

  <div class="oa-filter-group" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
    <label>Journals</label>
    <div class="team-label">Specialist Global Health Journals <span class="team-note">— all papers</span></div>
    <div class="concept-tags" id="aJournalTags" style="margin: 4px 0 8px;">
      <span class="concept-tag active" data-id="S4210176958" data-team="A">The Lancet Global Health</span>
      <span class="concept-tag active" data-id="S2764928273" data-team="A">BMJ Global Health</span>
      <span class="concept-tag active" data-id="S2736978234" data-team="A">Journal of Global Health</span>
      <span class="concept-tag active" data-id="S2765065622" data-team="A">Annals of Global Health</span>
      <span class="concept-tag active" data-id="S112714904" data-team="A">Globalization and Health</span>
    </div>
    <div class="team-label">Generalist Journals <span class="team-note">— SDG-tagged papers only</span></div>
    <div class="concept-tags" id="bJournalTags" style="margin: 4px 0 0;">
      <span class="concept-tag active" data-id="S49861241" data-team="B">The Lancet</span>
      <span class="concept-tag active" data-id="S4393917726" data-team="B">BMJ</span>
      <span class="concept-tag active" data-id="S62468778" data-team="B">NEJM</span>
      <span class="concept-tag active" data-id="S172573765" data-team="B">JAMA</span>
      <span class="concept-tag active" data-id="S197939330" data-team="B">PLoS Medicine</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="oa-filter-group">
    <label>Access</label>
    <select id="oaFilter">
      <option value="">All papers</option>
      <option value="true">Open access only</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div class="oa-filter-group">
    <label>Sort by</label>
    <select id="sortFilter">
      <option value="publication_date:desc">Newest first</option>
      <option value="cited_by_count:desc">Most cited</option>

  <div class="oa-filter-group">

    <select id="perPage">
      <option value="10">10</option>

<div class="oa-actions">
  <button class="btn-search" id="searchBtn" onclick="doSearch()">Search OpenAlex</button>

<div id="oaError" class="oa-error" style="display:none"></div>

<div class="oa-stats" id="oaStats" style="display:none">
  <div class="stat-box"><div class="label">Total results</div><div class="value" id="statTotal">&mdash;</div></div>
  <div class="stat-box"><div class="label">Open access on this page</div><div class="value" id="statOA">&mdash;</div></div>
  <div class="stat-box"><div class="label">Page</div><div class="value" id="statPage">&mdash;</div></div>
</div>

<div class="paper-list" id="paperList"></div>

<div class="pagination" id="oaPagination" style="display:none">
  <button class="page-btn" id="prevBtn" onclick="changePage(-1)" disabled>&larr; Prev</button>
  <span class="page-info" id="pageInfo"></span>
  <button class="page-btn" id="nextBtn" onclick="changePage(1)">Next &rarr;</button>
</div>

<script>
  let currentPage = 1;
  let totalResults = 0;
  let selectedSDGs = new Set();

  const SDG_LABELS = {
    1: 'SDG 1: No poverty',
    2: 'SDG 2: Zero hunger',
    3: 'SDG 3: Good health',
    4: 'SDG 4: Quality education',
    5: 'SDG 5: Gender equality',
    6: 'SDG 6: Clean water & sanitation',
    7: 'SDG 7: Clean energy',
    8: 'SDG 8: Decent work',
    9: 'SDG 9: Industry & innovation',
    10: 'SDG 10: Reduced inequalities',
    11: 'SDG 11: Sustainable cities & communities',
    12: 'SDG 12: Responsible consumption & production',
    13: 'SDG 13: Climate action',
    14: 'SDG 14: Life below water',
    15: 'SDG 15: Life on land',
    16: 'SDG 16: Peace, justice & strong institutions',
    17: 'SDG 17: Partnerships'
  };

  const selectedAJournals = new Set(
    Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#aJournalTags .concept-tag')).map(t => t.dataset.id)
  );
  const selectedBJournals = new Set(
    Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#bJournalTags .concept-tag')).map(t => t.dataset.id)
  );

  const today = new Date();
  const ago1w = new Date(today); ago1w.setDate(today.getDate() - 7);
  document.getElementById('fromDate').value = ago1w.toISOString().split('T')[0];
  document.getElementById('toDate').value = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];

  document.querySelectorAll('#sdgTags .concept-tag').forEach(tag => {
    tag.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const id = tag.dataset.id;
      if (selectedSDGs.has(id)) { selectedSDGs.delete(id); tag.classList.remove('active'); }
      else { selectedSDGs.add(id); tag.classList.add('active'); }
    });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('#aJournalTags .concept-tag').forEach(tag => {
    tag.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const id = tag.dataset.id;
      if (selectedAJournals.has(id)) { selectedAJournals.delete(id); tag.classList.remove('active'); }
      else { selectedAJournals.add(id); tag.classList.add('active'); }
    });
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('#bJournalTags .concept-tag').forEach(tag => {
    tag.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const id = tag.dataset.id;
      if (selectedBJournals.has(id)) { selectedBJournals.delete(id); tag.classList.remove('active'); }
      else { selectedBJournals.add(id); tag.classList.add('active'); }
    });
  });

  function buildCommonFilters(journalIds, sdgFilter = null) {
    const from = document.getElementById('fromDate').value;
    const to   = document.getElementById('toDate').value;
    const oa   = document.getElementById('oaFilter').value;
    let f = 'primary_location.source.id:' + Array.from(journalIds).join('|');
    if (sdgFilter) f += ',' + sdgFilter;
    if (from) f += ',from_publication_date:' + from;
    if (to)   f += ',to_publication_date:' + to;
    if (oa)   f += ',is_oa:' + oa;
    return f;
  }

  function buildBaseUrl(filters, page) {
    const sort = document.getElementById('sortFilter').value;
    const pp   = document.getElementById('perPage').value;
    return 'https://api.openalex.org/works?filter=' + filters +
      '&sort=' + sort + '&per-page=' + pp + '&page=' + page +
      '&select=id,title,doi,publication_date,primary_location,cited_by_count,open_access,authorships,sustainable_development_goals' +
      '&mailto=jackwgoodall@github';
  }

  function changePage(dir) { currentPage += dir; doSearch(false); }

  async function doSearch(reset = true) {
    if (reset) currentPage = 1;
    if (selectedAJournals.size === 0 && selectedBJournals.size === 0) {
      showError('Please select at least one journal.'); return;
    }
    const btn = document.getElementById('searchBtn');
    btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Searching\u2026';
    document.getElementById('oaError').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('oaStatus').textContent = 'Fetching from OpenAlex\u2026';
    document.getElementById('oaStatus').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('paperList').innerHTML = '';
    document.getElementById('oaStats').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('oaPagination').style.display = 'none';

    // Build SDG filter string — use selected SDGs if any, otherwise all 1-17 for B-team
    const sdgIds = selectedSDGs.size > 0
      ? Array.from(selectedSDGs).join('|')
      : Array.from({length: 17}, (_, i) => i + 1).join('|');
    const sdgFilter = 'sustainable_development_goals.id:' + sdgIds;

    try {
      const fetches = [];
      if (selectedAJournals.size > 0) fetches.push(
        fetch(buildBaseUrl(buildCommonFilters(selectedAJournals, null), currentPage))
          .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status); return r.json(); })
      );
      if (selectedBJournals.size > 0) fetches.push(
        fetch(buildBaseUrl(buildCommonFilters(selectedBJournals, sdgFilter), currentPage))
          .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status); return r.json(); })
      );
      const results = await Promise.all(fetches);
      let allWorks = [];
      totalResults = 0;
      results.forEach(data => {
        totalResults += data.meta ? data.meta.count : 0;
        allWorks = allWorks.concat(data.results || []);
      });
      const seen = new Set();
      allWorks = allWorks.filter(w => { if (seen.has(w.id)) return false; seen.add(w.id); return true; });
      const sort = document.getElementById('sortFilter').value;
      if (sort === 'publication_date:desc') {
        allWorks.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.publication_date || 0) - new Date(a.publication_date || 0));
      } else if (sort === 'cited_by_count:desc') {
        allWorks.sort((a, b) => (b.cited_by_count || 0) - (a.cited_by_count || 0));
      }
      const pp = parseInt(document.getElementById('perPage').value);
      document.getElementById('statTotal').textContent = totalResults.toLocaleString();
      document.getElementById('statOA').textContent = allWorks.filter(w => w.open_access && w.open_access.is_oa).length + ' / ' + allWorks.length;
      document.getElementById('statPage').textContent = currentPage + ' / ' + Math.ceil(totalResults / pp);
      document.getElementById('oaStats').style.display = 'grid';
      document.getElementById('oaStatus').style.display = 'none';
      if (allWorks.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('oaStatus').textContent = 'No results \u2014 try widening your date range or selecting more journals.';
        document.getElementById('oaStatus').style.display = 'block';
      } else {
        renderPapers(allWorks);
        const totalPages = Math.ceil(totalResults / pp);
        if (totalPages > 1) {
          document.getElementById('oaPagination').style.display = 'flex';
          document.getElementById('pageInfo').textContent = 'Page ' + currentPage + ' of ' + totalPages;
          document.getElementById('prevBtn').disabled = currentPage <= 1;
          document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled = currentPage >= totalPages;
        }
      }
    } catch(e) { showError('Could not fetch from OpenAlex: ' + e.message); }
    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Search OpenAlex';
  }

  function showError(msg) {
    document.getElementById('oaError').textContent = msg;
    document.getElementById('oaError').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('oaStatus').style.display = 'none';
  }

  function renderPapers(works) {
    document.getElementById('paperList').innerHTML = works.map(function(w) {
      const doi = w.doi ? w.doi.replace('https://doi.org/', '') : null;
      const doiUrl = doi ? 'https://doi.org/' + doi : null;
      const journal = w.primary_location && w.primary_location.source ? w.primary_location.source.display_name : '';
      const year = w.publication_date ? w.publication_date.slice(0, 4) : '';
      const cited = w.cited_by_count || 0;
      const authors = (w.authorships || []).slice(0, 3)
        .map(function(a) { return a.author && a.author.display_name ? a.author.display_name.split(' ').pop() : ''; })
        .filter(Boolean).join(', ');
      const more = (w.authorships && w.authorships.length > 3) ? ' +' + (w.authorships.length - 3) : '';
      const isOA = w.open_access && w.open_access.is_oa;
      const titleHtml = doiUrl ? '<a href="' + doiUrl + '" target="_blank">' + (w.title || 'Untitled') + '</a>' : (w.title || 'Untitled');

      // Build SDG badges from the sustainable_development_goals field
      const sdgBadges = (w.sustainable_development_goals || [])
      .map(function(s) {
        const num = parseInt(s.id.split('/').pop());
        return '<span class="badge badge-year">SDG ' + num + '</span>';
        }).join('');

      return '<div class="paper-card">' +
        '<div class="title">' + titleHtml + '</div>' +
        '<div class="authors">' + authors + more + '</div>' +
        '<div class="meta">' +
       (journal ? '<span class="badge badge-journal">' + journal + '</span>' : '') +
       (year ? '<span class="badge badge-year">' + year + '</span>' : '') +
       sdgBadges +
       (isOA ? '<span class="badge badge-oa">Open access</span>' : '') +
       (cited > 0 ? '<span class="badge badge-cite">' + cited + ' citations</span>' : '') +
        '</div></div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  doSearch();
</script>
```
